config.farmtweaks.title: Farm Tweaks
config.farmtweaks.features.rightClickHar: Enables right-click harvesting for mature crops.
Applies a Fortune-style bonus to non-seed drops from seed-replanting crops; carrots and potatoes use vanilla Fortune only.
config.farmtweaks.features.aoeHarvest.tt: Enables area harvesting with a hoe (disabled while sneaking).
config.farmtweaks.features.aoeTilling.tt: Enables area tilling with a hoe (disabled while sneaking).
config.farmtweaks.features.seedBags.tt: Enables Seed Bag items and their right-click behavior.
config.farmtweaks.features.flowerSeeds.t: Enables Flower Seeds and cultivable flower crops.
config.farmtweaks.features.xpPerCropEnab: Enables crop XP. When disabled, XP per crop is forced to 0.
config.farmtweaks.features.customWaterHy: Uses FarmTweaks' configured water scan range for farmland hydration.
config.farmtweaks.features.includeWaterl: Allows waterlogged blocks to hydrate farmland within the custom hydration range.
config.farmtweaks.features.pumpkinSlices: When enabled, pumpkins drop slices. Disable to keep vanilla pumpkin block drops.
config.farmtweaks.features.overridePumpk: Replaces vanilla pumpkin pie and seed recipes with FarmTweaks' slice recipes while pumpkin slices are enabled.
config.farmtweaks.features.preferCompati: Use another mod's compatible slice item, such as Farmer's Delight, when available.
config.farmtweaks.features.preventFarmla: Stops entities from turning farmland back into dirt by trampling it.
config.farmtweaks.restartRecipes.title: Restart required
config.farmtweaks.restartRecipes.message: Pumpkin recipe settings changed. Restart Minecraft now so the new recipes take effect?
config.farmtweaks.tuning.xpPerCrop.tt: XP awarded per mature crop harvested (disable via the XP rewards feature toggle).
config.farmtweaks.tuning.seedBagAoeShape: Initial shape for Seed Bags. Ctrl+scroll while holding one switches that bag between square and radial.
config.farmtweaks.controls.showModeHud.t: Shows the current Hoe or Seed Bag mode above the hotbar.
config.farmtweaks.controls.enableModeScr: Lets Ctrl+scroll switch Hoe modes and Seed Bag planting shapes.
config.farmtweaks.controls.invertModeScr: Reverses the direction used when Ctrl+scroll cycles modes.
config.farmtweaks.tuning.waterHydrationH: Horizontal distance water can hydrate farmland when custom hydration range is enabled. Vanilla is 4.
config.farmtweaks.tuning.waterHydrationV: Upward vertical distance water can hydrate farmland when custom hydration range is enabled. Vanilla checks 0 and 1.
config.farmtweaks.tuning.aoeTillingWoodR: Adds blocks around the targeted block for Wood hoe tilling (0 to 5). Footprint: (2 x range + 1) squared.
config.farmtweaks.tuning.aoeTillingStone: Adds blocks around the targeted block for Stone hoe tilling (1 to 6). Footprint: (2 x range + 1) squared.
config.farmtweaks.tuning.aoeTillingIronG: Adds blocks around the targeted block for Iron and Gold hoe tilling (2 to 7). Footprint: (2 x range + 1) squared.
config.farmtweaks.tuning.aoeTillingDiamo: Adds blocks around the targeted block for Diamond hoe tilling (3 to 8). Footprint: (2 x range + 1) squared.
config.farmtweaks.tuning.aoeTillingNethe: Adds blocks around the targeted block for Netherite hoe tilling (4 to 9). Footprint: (2 x range + 1) squared.
config.farmtweaks.tuning.flowerSeedDropC: Chance for a broken vanilla small flower to drop its matching Flower Seed.
